standard.summary: 默认 resident（Layer Offload 关闭，全部 block 常驻显存）；block_offload 在内存与显存之间流式搬运。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.block_offload: 按 block 卸，省显存，步进可能变慢。

standard_en.summary: resident is the default (Layer Offload off, every block resident in VRAM); block_offload streams them between system memory and VRAM.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.resident: Blocks stay resident on the GPU.
optionDescriptions.block_offload: Offloads block by block: saves VRAM, may slow the step down.

advanced.principle: 默认 resident（Layer Offload OFF）。OOM 再开 block_offload；勿未测抄 Klein 4/3。

advanced_en.principle: Default is resident (Layer Offload OFF). Only enable block_offload after an actual OOM; do not copy Klein's 4/3 without testing.
